Anita G: Heads up — saw a +28% p95 decode latency on main after the morning merge (CL 8421). CI perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/redwood/runs/1192. Reproduced locally on small harness.
Samir: ugh. which path? short/long seq? model? logs?
Anita G: Mostly shortseq (<=64). Model: redwood/llm-base-3b quantized. p50 stable. p95 jumps. Attached trace below.
Maria P: ```
kernel_select: attention_v0 -> fallback_attention_cuda
decode_step: attn kernel exec 4.1ms -> fallback 9.2ms
kv_cache: hit rate same
sched: batch size similar
```
Olek: looks like kernel selector flipped to fallback for shortseq after the merge. Probably heuristics threshold moved. I'll run bisect.
perf-bot: [ALERT] CI perf check failed: decode p95 +30% on canary for job build/1192
Samir: Can you run `git bisect start -- bad good`? I can help with a targeted bisect script.
Olek: running quick bisect across last 20 merges... sharing script:
```bash
git bisect start HEAD v/2026-03-10
git bisect run ./tools/run_perf.sh --arg model=llm-base-3b --seq=32 --iters=10
```
Anita G: note: KV eviction logs show occasional extra memcpy during prefetch path, maybe related.
Maria P: profile flame snippet: ```
attn_kernel_fast 40%
attn_fallback 60%
memcpy 12% (was 5% before)
```
Samir: If selector heuristics regressed, we likely need a hotpatch to pin selector until we fix. Can we canary a config on dedicated? deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: runtime/selector-pin-v2 -> canary-3 (10% traffic)
Olek: bisect iter 5 -> culprit merge 8372 (changes to kernel decision thresholds). Repro confirmed.
Anita G: proposing revert CL 8372 as hotpatch. Anyone object?
Maria P: +1 revert until we ship a proper fix. I'll open a regression test.
Samir: I'll file revert CL and coordinate with release. If revert isn't merged in 30m we escalate. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Revert CL 8372 submitted to staging, awaiting LGTM.
Anita G: thanks. keeping thread open — will post perf after canary reverts/rollout.
